title: Civil 3D workflows and connector status
description: Explore Civil 3D workflow ideas in Vector OS. Connector status: Upcoming. Development and release dates have not been announced.

Autodesk

Civil 3D

Civil 3D supports terrain, corridor, pipe-network and civil documentation workflows.

On the software discovery list. Connector development and release dates have not been announced.

Workflow ideas

Build an existing-ground surface

Use the selected building, infrastructure or plant elements and their current parameters. In the intended Civil 3D preview, build an existing-ground surface; the visible result is an updated model view that identifies each affected element. Review levels, connectivity, classification and design intent before accepting or exporting it.

Revise a road corridor

Start from the coordinated discipline context and current issue set. In the intended Civil 3D preview, revise a road corridor; the visible result is a comparison, check or automation result linked to model objects. Review element identity, clashes, rules and downstream effects before accepting or exporting it.

Update profiles and quantities

Begin with the accepted model proposal and document set. In the intended Civil 3D preview, update profiles and quantities; the visible result is updated schedules, drawings or issue information derived from the same subject. Review coordination status, quantities and publication scope before accepting or exporting it.
